thread:
Ana Torres: Heads-up — PraxisPay onboarding: we're seeing p95 tail ~2.3s on their dedicated pool during morning peak and token spend ~2.2x forecast. Renewal in ~36 days; marking as elevated risk. Proposing a proactive pilot: dynamic quantization profile (auto-select int8 vs mix4 based on seq_len) + regional tail routing to their us-east dedicated pool. Need eng + SRE + enablement to greenlight a short canary.

Benji Cole: can you drop the perf link and a short trace?

Ana Torres: dash: https://redwood.app/d/praxispay/ops?panelId=tailing
trace: `req=pp-900 seq=1..700 p50=120ms p95=2.3s model=redwood/sierra-13b`

Benji Cole: ok. my quick idea: serve a dynamic-quant variant that picks int8 for seq_len <=512 and mix4 for >512, and route sampled long requests (seq_len>512) to dedicated-us-east with a 10% sample for canary. Should reduce token-cost ~30-38% and ease scheduling pressure.

Ana Torres: dropping a canary snippet. cc @Ivy for enablement calendar.

Benji Cole: ```
# canary: dynamic quant + regional tail routing
selector: customer_id == "praxispay" && rand() < 0.10
model_profile: "sierra-13b-dynquant"
quant_rules:
  - when: seq_len <= 512
    use: "sierra-13b-int8"
  - when: seq_len > 512
    use: "sierra-13b-mix4"
route:
  - condition: seq_len > 512
    sample_rate: 0.10
    pool: "dedicated-praxispay-us-east"
fallback: "redwood/sierra-13b"
monitoring: slo_p95_ms=1300, compare_to=baseline
```

Ivy Lopez: I can run a 45-min enablement: 10m infra overview, 20m canary ops, 15m customer comms + renewal talking points. Slots Tue/Thu next week.

Maya Chen: please capture estimated savings for the renewal doc. conservative vs optimistic numbers.

Benji Cole: rough calc: baseline unit ~$0.019/token-eq; dynquant path ~34% lower (~$0.0126/token-eq). For their avg 2.6B tokens/mo that's ~ $40k/mo optimistic, conservative say $22k/mo until proven in canary. Will refine post-canary.

OpsAlert Bot: [metric alert] praxispay_prod_avg_seq_len +20% 24h; token_rate +14%. Created ticket CS-4509.

Ana Torres: linking CS-4509 so SRE can correlate infra metrics. @Carter SRE — can you check pool headroom & reserve a slot if ok?

Carter SRE: I can reserve a 1-GPU slot in dedicated-praxispay-us-east for 48h and add telemetry relabeling. Need IAM: ana@redwood, benji@redwood, ivy@redwood and expected peak rps.

Benji Cole: expected steady ~150 rps, spikes ~360. IAM listed above. I'll stage smoke tests and a small quality checkset to validate generations across quant profiles.

Maya Chen: I'll draft the customer-facing note: pilot scope, risk/rollback criteria, and estimated savings for renewal. Sharing for review before sending.

Ivy Lopez: include a short slide for execs showing p95 before/after, cost delta, and next steps. I'll slot the enablement once Carter confirms reservation.

Ana Torres: thanks team — aiming to kick the canary next Wednesday. Will update thread when reservation is confirmed :rocket:
